entities.name: Query protein MurE
observations: 502-residue sequence contains ambiguous X residues, preventing complete physicochemical calculations.
Homology supports UDP-N-acetylmuramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate--2,6-diaminopimelate ligase (MurE); reviewed homologs show 34.4–37.6% identity and 93.4–96.6% query coverage.
Pfam domains Mur_ligase_M (PF08245) occur at positions 119–318 and Mur_ligase_C (PF02875) at positions 340–468.
Likely cytosolic bacterial peptidoglycan-biosynthesis enzyme; exact substrate specificity is inferred from homologs.

entities.name: MurE ligase reaction
observations: UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-D-glutamate + meso-2,6-diaminopimelate + ATP yields UDP-N-acetyl-alpha-D-muramoyl-L-alanyl-gamma-D-glutamyl-meso-2,6-diaminopimelate + ADP + phosphate + H+; Rhea RHEA:23676.

entities.name: Peptidoglycan biosynthesis
observations: MurE homologs are annotated in bacterial cell-wall biogenesis and peptidoglycan biosynthesis; associated with cell division and regulation of cell shape.

entities.name: MurE Mg-ATP ligase chemistry
observations: MurE homologs bind ATP and Mg2+; EC 6.3.2.13. The query sequence contains the conserved Mur ligase domain architecture supporting this chemistry.
